wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext |prevcode=PG16 |prevtitle=The Beauty Eternal |nextcode=PG18 |nexttitle=The Redemption |series=Pokémon Generations |colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox |epcode=PG17 |colorscheme=Hoso |title_en=The Investigation |title_ja=捜査 |title_ja_trans=The Investigation |release_method=Web release |screen=hd |broadcast_jp=February 2, 2017 |broadcast_us=December 16, 2016 |en_op=N/A |ja_op=N/A |ja_ed=N/A |olmteam=Team Kato |scenario=冨岡淳広 |storyboard=安食圭 |director=安食圭 |art=高橋成之 |morecredits=no |epstaffpage=PG11-PG18 |footnotes=* ''[https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=PRvEVpdr8x8 The Investigation]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel * {{BMGf|220514|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Investigation''' (Japanese: '''捜査''' ''The Investigation'') is the seventeenth episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 16, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on February 2, 2017. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Detective Looker's assistants Emma and Mimi have been helping him out in Lumiose City, until a crime wave threatens to tear them apart. ==Plot== In the nightly alleyways of [[Lumiose City]], a {{pkmn|Trainer}} and her three {{p|Furfrou}} have been defeated by Essentia, a notorious Pokémon thief in a black suit and a face-covering helmet. As the Trainer [[recall]]s her fainted partners back into their {{i|Poké Ball}}s, Essentia activates her suit's "[[Poké Ball]] Jack" function, remotely stealing the three Poké Balls straight from her opponent's hands. Just then, [[Looker]] arrives and orders her to stop at once. The {{p|Espurr}} accompanying Looker, [[nickname]]d Mimi, approaches Essentia despite Looker's warnings and, to his surprise, starts affectionately rubbing itself against her leg. Essentia, however, suddenly proceeds to kick Mimi in the face, forcing Looker to catch it. The Pokémon thief makes a huge leap and starts running away on rooftops, while Mimi starts floating after her, with Looker on its tail. As the two pursue Essentia, Looker remembers the only person whom Mimi trusts that much, and stars wondering if the masked thief could in fact be [[Emma]]. Emma was an orphan girl with nowhere to go, so Looker took her under his care to work as his assistant at the [[Looker Bureau]], where she's been of tremendous help. However, recently, she's been disappearing without letting Looker know. With this in mind, Looker once again starts wondering if Essentia truly is Emma. Essentia eventually runs into [[Lysandre Café]], where Mimi and Looker corner her. Mimi glares at Essentia for a moment, before suddenly leaping and headbutting her face, cracking her helmet's screen. The helmet starts malfunctioning, until finally the person inside the suit screams and the screen shatters, revealing the person inside the suit to indeed be Emma. Looker catches Emma as she falls down. She opens her eyes and asks if today's experiment is already over. Looker asks Emma how did this happen, and Emma, upon recognizing them, responds by asking what he and Mimi are doing here. ==Major events== * [[Looker]] confronts Essentia, the {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} thief who has been stealing Pokémon from {{pkmn|Trainer}}s around [[Lumiose City]]. * Looker realizes that Essentia is actually [[Emma]], an orphan girl he had taken to live with him. * Emma's {{p|Espurr}}, Mimi, frees Emma from her mind control by destroying the Expansion Suit. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Looker]] * [[Emma|Emma/Essentia]] * {{tc|Tourist}} (flashback) * Trainer ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Espurr}} ([[Emma]]'s; Mimi) * {{p|Furfrou}} (Trainer's; ×3; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Furfrou|Star, Heart, and Diamond Trims}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FDBB99|bordercolor=FD7F4F |nl={{tt|Het onderzoek|The investigation}} |fr_eu={{tt|L’enquête|The investigation}} |de={{tt|Die Recherche|The Investigation}} |it={{tt|Le indagini|The investigation}} |ko={{tt|조사|The Investigation}} |pt_br={{tt|A Investigacão|The Investigation}} |es_eu={{tt|La investigación|The investigation}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext |prevcode=PG16 |prevtitle=The Beauty Eternal |nextcode=PG18 |nexttitle=The Redemption |series=Pokémon Generations |colorscheme=Hoso}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Generations episodes|17]] [[Category:Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time storyboarders]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time directors]] [[Category:Episodes animated by Nariyuki Takahashi]] [[Category:Episodes which aired in the United States before Japan]] [[de:Pokémon Generationen Folge 17: Die Recherche]] [[es:GEN17]] [[fr:PG17]] [[it:PG17]] [[ja:PG第17話]] [[zh:宝可梦世代 第17集]]
